channel.title: SecurityWizardry Vulnerability Radar (RMFconsultoria)
channel.description: Alertas de vulnerabilidade (CVSS) - fonte NVD (fallback quando o SecurityWizardry está bloqueado) - RMFconsultoria

item.title: CVE-2026-124472 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.6
item.description: Sunday 8 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.6 | OpenEMR before 8.3.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in interface/billing/sl_eob_patient_note.php that allows any authenticated user to read and modify patient billing notes. Attackers with low-privilege accounts can enumerate the patient_id parameter and submit POST requests using the embedded CSRF token to view or tamper with confidential billing data.

item.title: CVE-2026-124473 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 7.1
item.description: Sunday 8 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 7.1 | OpenEMR before 8.3.0 contains a broken object-level authorization vulnerability in the SOAP note update API, which does not verify that the supplied SOAP note ID (sid) belongs to the supplied patient and encounter. Authenticated users with encounters/notes permission can send PUT requests to /api/patient/:pid/encounter/:eid/soap_note/:sid with another patient's sid to overwrite that clinical note and reassign its pid.

item.title: CVE-2026-124474 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.3
item.description: Sunday 8 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.3 | MRBS (Meeting Room Booking System) before 1.12.3 contains a reflected cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to inject script via the error parameter of view_entry.php. Attackers can send crafted links to logged-in users to read CSRF tokens, modify or delete bookings, or perform administrative actions.

item.title: CVE-2026-124475 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 7.1
item.description: Sunday 8 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 7.1 | OpenEMR before 8.3.0 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability in portal/lib/persist.php that allows authenticated portal patients to modify other patients' settings by supplying an arbitrary setting_patient value. Attackers can insert or overwrite patient_settings rows for victims to suppress notifications, tamper with consent flags, or alter portal preferences.

item.title: CVE-2026-124476 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 7.1
item.description: Sunday 8 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 7.1 | OpenEMR before 8.3.0 contains an insecure direct object reference in portal/lib/paylib.php, which writes the request-supplied form_pid (or the patient_id_cc value in Sphere data) to onsite_portal_activity without checking it against the session patient. Authenticated portal patients can submit portal-save, review-save, AuthorizeNet, Stripe, or Sphere requests to insert or modify forged payment-audit records in other patients' billing records.

item.title: CVE-2026-124477 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7
item.description: Sunday 8 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7 | OpenEMR before 8.3.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows low-privileged authenticated users to delete arbitrary patient recall records via the delete_Recall action. Attackers can send POST requests to /interface/main/messages/save.php with a target pid and r_ID to remove recall data without ACL or ownership checks.

item.title: CVE-2026-124478 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 7.1
item.description: Sunday 8 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 7.1 | OpenEMR before 8.3.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the addRecall action of /interface/main/messages/save.php that allows low-privileged authenticated users to modify arbitrary patients' recall data. Attackers can submit a crafted new_pid with recall, contact, provider, facility, and notification preference fields to overwrite records of patients they cannot access.

item.title: CVE-2026-124479 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 7.1
item.description: Sunday 8 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 7.1 | OpenEMR before 8.4.0 contains an arbitrary local file read vulnerability in REST document download, where the controller passes stored uploaded document bytes to Symfony's BinaryFileResponse as a filesystem path instead of returning them as content. Authenticated users with document upload and download access can upload a document containing an absolute pathname, such as the sqlconf.php location, then download it to read server files and recover database credentials.

item.title: CVE-2026-124480 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7
item.description: Sunday 8 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7 | OpenEMR before 8.4.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows low-privileged authenticated users to read cross-patient FHIR QuestionnaireResponse data by sending the APICSRFTOKEN header. Attackers can reuse the session-exposed api_csrf_token_js value to skip FHIR scope checks and call GET /fhir/QuestionnaireResponse, exfiltrating site-wide questionnaire answer PHI.

item.title: CVE-2026-124481 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 7.1
item.description: Sunday 8 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 7.1 | OpenEMR before 8.4.0 contains an improper authorization vulnerability in Rainforest patient portal payments that trusts browser-supplied patientId, encounter, and amount values instead of deriving them from the portal session. Authenticated portal patients can tamper with JSON sent to portal_payment.rainforest.php so the payin.authorized webhook writes forged ar_activity credits to other patients' encounters exceeding the amount actually paid.

item.title: CVE-2026-124482 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 7.1
item.description: Sunday 8 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 7.1 | OpenEMR before 8.4.0 contains an authorization bypass allowing low-privileged SMART standalone-launch users to bind arbitrary patient UUIDs into the OAuth token context. Attackers with only the patients|demo ACL can select a victim during authorization and read that patient's clinical notes and documents through patient-scoped DocumentReference and Binary FHIR endpoints.

item.title: CVE-2026-124483 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7
item.description: Sunday 8 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7 | OpenEMR before 8.4.0 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability because the prescription REST API routes check the patients.med ACL instead of patients.rx and request no specific permission bit, so read-only Medical/History access passes the check. Authenticated staff users can reuse the UI-exposed APICSRFTOKEN to enumerate prescription UUIDs, forge prescriptions for arbitrary patients, and deactivate existing prescriptions tenant-wide.

item.title: CVE-2026-124484 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7
item.description: Sunday 8 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7 | OpenEMR before 8.4.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in portal onsite-document APIs that allows any authenticated core user to access cross-patient documents. Attackers can omit the patientId parameter and supply arbitrary record IDs to list, read, and overwrite other patients' portal documents, signatures, and template data.

item.title: CVE-2026-124485 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 7.1
item.description: Sunday 8 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 7.1 | OpenEMR before 8.3.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in the patient portal onsitedocuments API that allows authenticated patients to read other patients' documents by overriding query criteria. Attackers can send empty pid_Equals and denialReason_IsNotLike parameters to remove patient scoping and locked filters, exposing consent bodies, signatures, file paths, and template data.

item.title: CVE-2026-124486 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7
item.description: Sunday 8 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7 | OpenEMR before 8.3.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the classic document controller that allows low-privilege authenticated users to recategorize other patients' documents. Attackers can invoke move_action_process to move a document into a patients|demo category, then retrieve it with an empty patient_id to exfiltrate PHI and tamper with charts.

item.title: CVE-2026-124487 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 7.1
item.description: Sunday 8 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 7.1 | OpenEMR before 8.4.0 contains an improper authorization vulnerability in the non-patient POST /fhir/DocumentReference/$docref route that allows low-privileged users to generate any patient's CCDA. Attackers with only demographics and documents permissions can supply a victim patient parameter, then download the full-chart CCDA from Patient Documents to exfiltrate clinical data.

item.title: CVE-2026-124488 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.6
item.description: Sunday 8 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.6 | OpenEMR before 8.3.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated clinicians lacking high-sensitivity permission to read and modify encounter-bound forms via load_form.php. Attackers can request the Clinical Notes or Care Plan direct loader to obtain restricted content and a CSRF token, then submit save.php to tamper with clinical records.

item.title: CVE-2026-124489 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 7.1
item.description: Sunday 8 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 7.1 | OpenEMR before 8.3.0 contains a broken access control vulnerability in portal/portal_payment.php that allows low-privilege authenticated users to bypass billing ACL checks by tampering patient identifiers. Attackers can modify the pid and form_pid parameters to view payment pages and record fraudulent payment receipts for arbitrary patients, corrupting billing records.

item.title: CVE-2026-124490 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 9.4
item.description: Sunday 8 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 9.4 | OpenEMR before 8.3.0 contains a path traversal vulnerability in the RingCentral RCFaxClient disposeDocument() method of oe-module-faxsms that allows authenticated attackers to read and write arbitrary files via the file_path parameter. Attackers can use action=download to read credentials and source code, or action=setup with base64 content to write web-executable files for code execution.

item.title: CVE-2026-124491 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.3
item.description: Sunday 8 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.3 | SunEditor before 3.4.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in the FileUpload plugin create() method that assigns server-returned file names to innerHTML without escaping. Attackers can upload files with HTML-laden names that bypass html.clean() and execute JavaScript in victims' browsers when content or gallery items load, enabling session theft.

item.title: CVE-2026-124492 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.3
item.description: Sunday 8 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.3 | SunEditor before 3.4.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in ModalAnchorEditor's #createBookmarkList, which inserts entity-decoded h1-h6 header textContent into the bookmark list via innerHTML without escaping. Attackers can store HTML-encoded payloads in editor headers that execute JavaScript when a victim opens the link modal and types # in the URL input.

item.title: CVE-2026-124493 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 9.3
item.description: Sunday 8 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 9.3 | SunEditor before 3.4.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in the DocumentType constructor that injects header textContent into innerHTML without HTML escaping. Attackers can store entity-encoded HTML in h1-h6 headers that executes JavaScript when editors using document:header mode initialize, enabling session cookie theft.

item.title: CVE-2026-124494 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 9.3
item.description: Sunday 8 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 9.3 | SunEditor before 3.4.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability because the html.clean() sanitizer's _normalizeURL() function decodes named entities like : to an empty string. Attackers can inject href values such as javascript: that pass the _isSafeURL() check but are decoded by browsers, executing JavaScript when victims click stored links.

item.title: CVE-2026-124551 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.0
item.description: Sunday 8 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.0 | ClassroomIO through 1.0.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated users of any organization to clone other tenants' courses via the POST /course/:courseId/clone endpoint. Attackers who know a target course id can copy its sections, lessons, exercises, and quiz answer keys into their own organization, exposing private course content.

item.title: CVE-2026-124552 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 4.8
item.description: Sunday 8 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 4.8 | Webmin through 2.670 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in the Shorewall and Shorewall6 modules' list.cgi, which renders table fields and COMMENT lines unescaped. Authenticated users with table edit permission can store JavaScript via savecmt.cgi or table entries that executes when other users, including root, view the list page.

item.title: CVE-2026-124553 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7
item.description: Sunday 8 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7 | BabelDOC from 0.3.61 before 0.7.0 contains a resource exhaustion vulnerability that allows remote attackers to exhaust CPU and memory by supplying unbounded bfrange and cidrange spans. Attackers can submit a crafted PDF whose embedded ToUnicode CMap declares a huge range, driving billions of loop iterations and stalling the translation worker.

item.description: Sunday 8 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 5.3 | IBM Engineering Requirements Management DOORS Next 7.1, and 7.2 could allow a remote attacker to force the Web server to return contents of a sensitive requested file due to improper input validation.

item.title: CVE-2025-36075 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 5.3
item.description: Sunday 8 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 5.3 | IBM Safer Payments 6.4.0.00 through 6.4.2.11, 6.5.0.00 through 6.5.0.09, 6.6.0.00 through 6.6.0.07, 6.7.0.00 through 6.7.0.03, and 6.8.0.00 could allow an authenticated user to obtain sensitive information, caused by improper user input validation. By using a set of API requests the user could exploit this vulnerability to decrypt sensitive information.

item.description: Sunday 8 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 9.1 | IBM WebSphere Extreme Scale 8.6.1.0 through 8.6.2.2 could allow a remote attacker to bypass security restrictions due to improper Content Security Policy configuration.
